children: South Korea's downstream oil and gas sector is likely to remain stable in 2026, despite pressure from elevated freight costs and geopolitical risks, BMI says in a report. The Fitch Solutions unit sees the country shifting toward a broader energy-security strategy focused on reducing its dependence on Middle Eastern crude. The government aims to reduce the Middle Eastern share of crude imports to 60% or less, from 69.1% in 2024, it notes. Latest energy import data show the country's increased sourcing flexibility, with the Middle East accounting for 62.8% of crude imports in the January-May period and the Americas, including the U.S., accounting for 26.6% in May, it adds. (kwanwoo.jun@wsj.com)
